svg.title: Group-stage results by team
svg.desc: Stacked bars show each team's six group-stage outcomes, with wins in teal, draws in gold and losses in coral.
svg.text: Wins, draws and losses · ordered by points, goal difference and goals scored · 6 matches per team

a.text: Source: UEFA 2023/24 group-stage fixtures and results (click to open)

svg.text: Outcomes are team-level results; per-match tactical or player measures are not available in this dataset.
